script.title: Ghost tapping scam: check 1 screen before you tap
script.hook: 1 tap at a holiday market, and a $15 box of cookies turns into a $1,500 charge.

segments.heading: Hook
segments.narration: A holiday market. A stand selling cookies, fifteen dollars, tap here. You tap without looking. Later your bank app shows fifteen hundred.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a card reader at a market stall No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: How
segments.narration: The BBB says fake stands and charity collectors ask you to tap, then charge far more than they said. In crowds, someone may brush past with a reader.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a crowded market with a hidden reader No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The check
segments.narration: Before you tap, read two things on the reader's screen: the business name and the amount. No screen, or they won't show you? Don't tap.
segments.on_screen_text: Read the name and the amount
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a terminal screen with two circles No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Do this
segments.narration: Turn on alerts for every charge, and swipe or insert if anything feels off. Charged wrong? Call your bank on the number on your card.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the small round teal shield mascot with big curious eyes holding a phone with an alert No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Hook

segments.heading: The rule
segments.narration: The FTC is blunt: the moment someone tells you to pay to claim a prize, it's a scam. Real sweepstakes are free and by chance.
segments.on_screen_text: Pay to claim? It's a scam.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a prize check with a fee stamped on it No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: The trick
segments.narration: Caller ID can be faked to show a real company or charity name, and scammers borrow real charity names too, so the name proves nothing.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. a phone screen with a mask No text, no logos, no real people.

segments.heading: Do this
segments.narration: Hang up. Never pay to get a prize. Want to give this week? Look the charity up yourself, past the ads at the top of the search.
segments.on_screen_text: Never pay to win. Look it up.
segments.visual_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration, deep navy and cream with teal and amber warning accents, simple shapes. the small round teal shield mascot with big curious eyes hanging up a phone No text, no logos, no real people.
